title: Chatstream Capabilities
description: What a provider's stream can and cannot do (go-chatstream Capabilities). Static and immutable; consumers adapt to it. Go declares no JSON tags, so keys are the Go field names and the enums are their numeric values.

Tools.description: The dialect carries tool calls at all.

ReasoningRoundTrip.description: A signature or encrypted value must be sent back with the next request.

InterleavedParts.description: Parts may be open at the same time.

Cancel.description: The upstream can be canceled mid-stream.

ResumeCursor.description: The upstream can resume from a cursor.

Granularity.description: 0 none, 1 token (many small deltas), 2 chunk (a few larger deltas), 3 final (the whole value once, at the end).

Framing.description: 0 unset, 1 SSE, 2 NDJSON, 3 JSON-RPC lines. A declaration with framing unset is invalid in Go.
